title: Make a mail rule
goal: Make a rule that moves emails from one sender into a mailbox

steps.say: Open the Mail menu at the top left and choose Settings.
steps.find: the Mail menu in the menu bar

steps.say: Click Rules at the top of the Settings window.
Type a name for the rule in the Description box.
Set the condition to From contains, then type the sender's address.
Set the action to Move Message, then pick the mailbox.
steps.find: the action menus under Perform the following actions

instead.say: If the menus are hidden, make the window bigger so the actions show.
instead.find: the bottom edge of the rule window

steps.say: Click OK. Mail asks whether to apply it to messages you already have.
